patterns.pattern_name: Component master + SDW child split lifecycle
patterns.description: LE codec driver acts as component master and binds SDW rx/tx children before component registration.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Uses upstream component framework and deterministic bind/unbind ordering.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Requires rx/tx SDW device nodes and valid child probe order.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Copy lifecycle shape, not WCD938x-specific symbols or IDs.

patterns.pattern_name: SDW probe with tx-only regmap bring-up
patterns.description: LE SDW probe derives rx/tx role from DT port-mapping and initializes regmap on tx side with cache-only bootstrap.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Matches SDW framework behavior before attach/interrupt readiness.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Only valid if WCD9378 also uses tx-side CSR access.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Do not assume WCD9378 uses identical channel counts/port maps without downstream proof.

patterns.pattern_name: Regcache state transitions on attach and runtime PM
patterns.description: LE enables cache-only during early bring-up, clears cache-only on attach/resume, and syncs cache to hardware.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Uses regcache APIs instead of custom synchronization logic.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Identity/paging still require runtime evidence for WCD9378.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Do not interpret cache-sync success as proof of runtime audio correctness.

patterns.pattern_name: Shared DT micbias parsing via wcd-common
patterns.description: LE reads qcom,micbias*-microvolt through common helper and stores converted vout values in shared state.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Avoids codec-local duplicated DT parsing for micbias rails.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Micbias count and index mapping must match WCD9378 hardware definition.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Do not carry over LA qcom,cdc-micbias*-mv properties.

patterns.description: LE wires MBHC interrupt IDs from regmap-irq virtual IRQs and relies on shared start/stop/init/deinit APIs.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Common MBHC behavior is centralized and reusable across codecs.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Field mapping must be register-accurate for WCD9378.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Do not import LA-specific MBHC wrapper APIs.

patterns.description: LE allocates class-H controller with codec version enum and drives state transitions from DAPM callbacks.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Single shared class-H engine reduces per-codec divergence.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: WCD9378 enum/base decision remains runtime-sensitive and currently fail-closed.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Do not assume WCD9378 can reuse WCD937X/WCD938X enum without Monday evidence.

patterns.pattern_name: Runtime PM on both codec and SDW device
patterns.description: LE enables autosuspend and PM runtime for aggregate and SDW children, with explicit suspend/resume hooks for regcache.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Consistent with kernel PM model and avoids vendor PM sleep hooks.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Audio path behavior still requires runtime validation.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Do not convert PM-only success into playback/capture success claims.

patterns.description: LE uses devm_gpiod_get/reset toggling rather than vendor pinctrl-state APIs.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Requires DTS reset-gpios wiring on target board.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Do not preserve LA qcom,wcd-rst-gpio-node dependency.

patterns.description: LE enables required supplies with devm_regulator_bulk_get_enable during probe setup.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Removes custom regulator orchestrators and board-specific supply states.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Supply names and count must match WCD9378 bindings/runtime evidence.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Do not copy LA msm_cdc supply-lpm policy directly.

patterns.pattern_name: Device-link ordering between aggregate codec and SDW children
patterns.description: LE creates stateless PM runtime links to guarantee tx/rx dependency and suspend ordering.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Framework-consistent dependency declaration replaces implicit ordering assumptions.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Must preserve valid unwind path on any link creation failure.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Do not add fixed delays as a substitute for dependency links.

patterns.description: LE keeps controls/widgets/routes centralized and links power events to shared MBHC/Class-H helpers.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Maintainers can review topology and event effects in a consistent file layout.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Topology can be reused only where downstream/datasheet prove equivalent blocks.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Avoid name-only cloning of control lists.

patterns.description: LE separates codec core and SDW transport symbols while ensuring linked object inclusion when SDW symbol is enabled.
patterns.why_upstreamable: Build ordering and link dependencies are explicit and reproducible.
patterns.conditions_or_caveats: Feature dependencies must match actual helper/library usage.
patterns.anti_copy_warning: Do not replicate LA external-module Kbuild conditionals.
